concept: Weird 117 film: Center Girl comes alive (small black spiders pour out of the cracks of the artwork in a dense swarm), then everything turns into pink bubblegum that stretches, inflates into bubbles and pops, it becomes a nervous butcher sharpening long knives, the blades shining, ending on 117 made of raw pink meat with white fat marbling, on a butcher's wooden block
audio_source: original synthesized sound bed generated locally with ffmpeg (noise, drones, blips); no third-party audio
